name: OH SHI
capability_status: Read data.capabilityAvailability from /api/v1/coverage before using investor filters, signals, or off-board openings.
conditional_requests: Stable documentation and aggregate capability surfaces return ETag and honor If-None-Match.
request_identification: Send a descriptive User-Agent identifying your agent and operator; anonymous or browser-impersonating traffic may be challenged at the edge.
pagination: Pass page.next_cursor unchanged with the same view and filters; job page.total is the complete matching count.
change_feed: /api/v1/changes?after={initial.incremental.after}; then pass the exclusive tuple cursor unchanged
checkpoint_recovery: Retry a page until committed; on HTTP 410 checkpoint_expired, run a fresh initial jobs query.
canonical_job_rule: A job is verified open only when its canonical source still lists it.
